import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { orders } from "./orders";
import { territories } from "./territories";

export const employees = defineTable("employees", {
    columns: {
        employeeId: col.smallint().primaryKey(),
        lastName: col.varchar({ length: 20 }).notNull(),
        firstName: col.varchar({ length: 10 }).notNull(),
        title: col.varchar({ length: 30 }),
        titleOfCourtesy: col.varchar({ length: 25 }),
        birthDate: col.date(),
        hireDate: col.date(),
        address: col.varchar({ length: 60 }),
        city: col.varchar({ length: 15 }),
        region: col.varchar({ length: 15 }),
        postalCode: col.varchar({ length: 10 }),
        country: col.varchar({ length: 15 }),
        homePhone: col.varchar({ length: 24 }),
        extension: col.varchar({ length: 4 }),
        photo: col.bytea(),
        notes: col.text(),
        reportsTo: col.smallint(),
        photoPath: col.varchar({ length: 255 })
    },
    relations: {
        reportsToRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => employees, { localKey: "reports_to", onDelete: "no action" }),
        employees: rel.hasMany(() => employees, { foreignKey: "reports_to" }),
        orders: rel.hasMany(() => orders),
        territories: rel.manyToMany(() => territories, { through: "employee_territories" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
